hypotheses.title: Subindustry Financial Leverage Beta and Short-Term Price Reversion Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms with higher financial leverage (liabilities normalized by total assets) within their subindustry possess higher operational and financial risk betas that earn an equity risk premium over quarterly horizons. Applying a non-linear quadratic power transform sharpens exposure to extreme capital structure dispersion while an orthogonal 15% short-term 5-day delta price reversal overlay captures microstructure mean reversion, maximizing risk-adjusted return and stabilizing drawdowns.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if higher leverage leads to widespread financial distress downgrades that impair equity returns relative to sector peers.

candidates.rationale: Path C (Rated GOOD): Quadratic power-scaled subindustry financial leverage with 15% 5-day delta reversal stabilizer
Path B (Rated Average): Linear subindustry financial leverage with 20% 5-day delta reversal stabilizer
